Round 5 complete. One candidate node created, evaluated, and committed.

## Analysis (Stage 1)

Inspecting the DAG (`main → adaed03 → 32b0dc3 → 3a72aec → d4199a2`), I selected the strongest node **d4199a2 (panel vote, avg 0.5467)** as parent and replayed all recorded traces of the five runs from `/workspace/runs`:

- The prompt, skill and frozen memories are byte-identical across all runs, so every raw reply is an independent draw of the same question.
- Re-voting the pooled replies over a fixed example set with 8 draws each (30/50/45 examples, 1000 partitions per point) shows the exact-answer vote **still climbing past the shipped cap of 5**: USPTO 0.2291 (k=5) → 0.2437 (k=6) → 0.2589 (k=8), S2D/LawBench essentially flat.
- The parent run left budget unspent (USPTO mean 16.2 of 32 model calls, 337s of 900s; 10/60 samples stopped by the 450s check), and 3 USPTO samples returned a single reply because one dead draw ended the panel outright.
- Measured dead before spending the change: canonical/order-insensitive vote keys (0 sample changes), memory-support ranking (never fires), vote-then-ground vs ground-then-vote (identical), component-majority/union/longest (equal or worse).

## Modification (Stage 2)

Branch `panel-budget-draws` from d4199a2; only `solver/agent.py` changed: `PANEL_SIZE 5→8`, `PANEL_BUDGET 0.5→0.6`, a new `_out_of_budget` guard that starts a draw only if the slowest draw so far would still fit, and dead draws are now lost draws (`PANEL_FAILURES = 2` consecutive failures end the panel) instead of ending it immediately. Loop semantics unit-checked against a stub agent (8 checks, no model call).

## Evaluation (one run, `fcc91464`)

`{"USPTO": 0.3167, "Symptom2Disease": 0.85, "LawBench": 0.55, "average": 0.5722, "status": "partial"}` — parents's `0.5467`. USPTO +0.0667 against a +0.0298 counterfactual; draws/sample rose 4.47→5.77, 4.34→6.17, 3.24→3.49 (max 5→8), and on the run's own replies the panel beats its first draw 18/59 vs 14/59 (USPTO). Cost: calls 2609→3283, tokens 30.0M→35.8M, but wall clock 1738s→1513s thanks to the budget guard. Three samples lost, all on the first draw (one USPTO slow-call timeout, two LawBench `content_filter`).

Audit: tree hash matches the manifest, sha256 of the source identical before/after, HEAD never moved during the run, `git status` clean. Note attached under `refs/notes/evolution` to `b51ec0b`.
